_doc: EXAMPLE ONLY -- documents the velocity_calib.json schema (VescDriver/src/VelocityMap.h): a monotone piecewise-linear v<->erpm map, used by DriverCore's actuation="governor" backend to convert a velocity setpoint into a target erpm for SpeedGovernor. This 2-point table is deliberately LINEAR-EQUIVALENT (erpm = 4614*v exactly) -- i.e. loading this example produces the same conversion as the linear_fallback below, or as no file at all with driver_config.json's own default erpm_per_mps=4614. Replace 'table' with a real fitted multi-point curve from a calibration campaign for an actual robot.
_min_reliable_erpm_doc: PLACEHOLDER -- below this |erpm| the VESC's own erpm estimate is considered too noisy to trust for closed-loop feedback; not enforced by VelocityMap itself (informational for callers/telemetry).
_linear_fallback_doc: Used only when 'table' is absent -- matches driver_config.json's own placeholder erpm_per_mps.

meta.notes: Example velocity calibration file for tests/documentation only -- NOT fit from a real VESC.
